patterns: Backend: pytest markers (unit/contract/integration), asyncio_mode=auto, httpx AsyncClient
Backend test files: tests/api/test_*.py (contract), tests/unit/*/test_*.py (unit), tests/integration/test_*_smoke.py
Frontend test files: src/pages/*.test.tsx, src/hooks/*.test.tsx, src/components/*/*.test.tsx
integration_points: New backend tests: packages/api/tests/api/ for route contract tests
New frontend tests: packages/web/src/pages/*.test.tsx for new pages
New hook tests: packages/web/src/hooks/*.test.tsx for new hooks
constraints: Backend uses mock_db and mock_neo4j_driver fixtures from conftest.py
vp test for frontend, pytest for backend
